channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Pau Gasol | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Pau Gasol from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Anthony Davis on Pau Gasol
item.description:
HoopsHype: Anthony Davis on Pau Gasol's jersey retirement:

“That's a huge honor to be up there with the greats and he deserves it. The list of big men that came to this organization, dominated, and left their mark, it's hard not to think about it. Obviously, I want to be in that group.”

Anthony Davis on Pau Gasol, Mar 8, 2023. Source: Twitter @hoopshype.

item.title: Carmelo Anthony on Pau Gasol, Luis Scola
item.description:
Here’s the full FIBA announcement on Carmelo Anthony becoming the Global Ambassador for the 2023 FIBA World Cup, which will tip off on August 25 in the Philippines, Japan and Indonesia:

“Joining the recently announced Argentina superstar Luis Scola and Spain legend Pau Gasol as Global Ambassadors, Carmelo Anthony will help promote the World Cup and take part in activities in the buildup to FIBA’s flagship men’s competition.“I’ve proudly represented the USA on the world’s largest stages, and the World Cup is the toughest competition in international basketball,”

Carmelo Anthony on Pau Gasol, Luis Scola, Feb 24, 2023. Source: EuroHoops.net.

item.title: Kristaps Porzingis on Kobe Bryant, Pau Gasol, Dirk Nowitzki
item.description:
Kristaps Porzingis was dubbed the 'Unicorn' by Durant early in his career because he was especially unique, but now there are a few players with the same pedigree following in his footsteps.

“Dirk Nowitzki was a superstar and of course he made the style of play much more acceptable by what he was doing and for everyone else after him. I grew up watching him, I grew up watching Pau Gasol and Kobe [Bryant],”

Kristaps Porzingis on Kobe Bryant, Pau Gasol, Dirk Nowitzki, Oct 3, 2022. Source: NBC Sports.

item.title: Marc Gasol on Pau Gasol
item.description:
Marc Gasol on Pau Gasol's future:

“Pau has to know first his foot is ok, and then decide. He wants to play in the Olympics and maybe keep playing after that,but the most important thing is his health.”

Marc Gasol on Pau Gasol, Nov 14, 2020. Source: ccma.cat.

item.title: Tony Parker on Pau Gasol, Dirk Nowitzki
item.description:
“It had a huge impact in Europe. If you see interviews that I did or Dirk [Nowitzki] or Pau Gasol, we all were affected by the Dream Team,”

Tony Parker on Pau Gasol, Dirk Nowitzki, May 7, 2020. Source: EuroHoops.net.

item.title: Skal Labissiere on Pau Gasol
item.description:
Skal Labissiere said he’s never been on a team that has had a player as accomplished as Gasol at his position.

“I grew up watching him. I remember being in Haiti, in front of my little TV and just watching Pau Gasol,”

Skal Labissiere on Pau Gasol, Oct 5, 2019. Source: Associated Press.

item.title: Marc Gasol on Rasheed Wallace, Pau Gasol
item.description:
Classic Marc Gasol on getting Finals advice from Pau Gasol:

“He was playing Boston at that time and then he played Orlando and third year he played Boston again. What could I ask him, like how to guard Rasheed Wallace?”

Marc Gasol on Rasheed Wallace, Pau Gasol, Jun 6, 2019. Source: Twitter @WolstatSun.

item.title: Gregg Popovich on Pau Gasol
item.description:
Paul Garcia:Pop on Pau Gasol:

“Pau's a class act. You know, he wants to play. The way we're constituted and in our plan, he wasn't getting those minutes. So we tried to work something out and it happens. He'll do great work in Milwaukee with (Coach) Bud.”

Gregg Popovich on Pau Gasol, Mar 2, 2019. Source: Twitter @PaulGarciaNBA.

item.title: RC Buford on Pau Gasol, LaMarcus Aldridge
item.description:
“I think Pau [Gasol] and LaMarcus have obviously been significant and the contributions of other guys who have filled in and come together well. We're obviously not the best team in the league. But the group has taken care of its responsibilities in a way that puts them in a position to win.”

RC Buford on Pau Gasol, LaMarcus Aldridge, Nov 29, 2017. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Ufuk Sarica on Pau Gasol
item.description:
However, Ufuk Sarica decided to begin his comments during the post-game press conference by applauding Pau’s presence with the national team in yet another summer tournament.

“First and foremost I want to express my respect for the Spanish Team. Especially Pau Gasol. He’s 37 years old and he goes through an intense summer camp. And after a very long season he fights with the whole until the very end. You see the whole team is together with him in this effort. I think he sets a good example for future generations that want to play basketball. I’d like to point out that. That I really respect Pau Gasol and the Spanish team in particular,”

Ufuk Sarica on Pau Gasol, Sep 10, 2017. Source: EuroHoops.net.

item.title: Lamar Odom on Pau Gasol
item.description:
“If someone brought me something crazy. Portland was in it, no lie. After we got Pau [Gasol in 2008], it was easy for us. I just kept that in mind. It was a wrap after we got Pau. His first game was amazing, and he didn’t even know the triangle. Playing with him, playing off of him, he was easy to play with. He knows the game so well, and he’s so talented. Right hand, left hand, right hook, left hook, back hook, fadeaway. “He’s another competitor. People don’t give him enough credit for that. He competes.”

Lamar Odom on Pau Gasol, Aug 29, 2017. Source: Yahoo! Sports.

item.title: Tony Parker on Pau Gasol
item.description:
Tony Parker on playing with Pau Gasol:

“It's great to finish like that! I played against him since I was 14 years with the national team: cadets, juniors and seniors... Then in the NBA, it's great fun! He's such a good player, a good passer. I hope we will have a great season.”

Tony Parker on Pau Gasol, Oct 4, 2016. Source: SFR Sport.

item.title: David Lee on Pau Gasol, LaMarcus Aldridge
item.description:
“Those two guys (Aldridge and Gasol) are established All-Stars. I want to come in here and whatever minutes I’m given,I’m going to play them with energy.”

David Lee on Pau Gasol, LaMarcus Aldridge, Sep 29, 2016. Source: San Antonio Express-News.

item.title: Sergio Scariolo on Pau Gasol
item.description:
Sergio Scariolo:

“Pau Gasol is not OK, I can't say if he's going to play against USA.”

Sergio Scariolo on Pau Gasol, Aug 18, 2016. Source: Marca.com.

item.title: Tony Parker on Pau Gasol
item.description:
Tom Orsborn:Tony Parker on possibly of facing new teammate Pau Gasol in Rio:

“I've been playing Pau since I was 14. I've been playing against him forever.”

Tony Parker on Pau Gasol, Jul 26, 2016. Source: Twitter @tom_orsborn.

item.title: Taj Gibson on Pau Gasol, Doug McDermott, Bobby Portis
item.description:
“I sit there and listen to (Gasol) talk. He talks to Doug (McDermott), he talks to Bobby (Portis),”

Taj Gibson on Pau Gasol, Doug McDermott, Bobby Portis, Feb 20, 2016. Source: CSN Chicago.

item.title: Jimmy Butler on Pau Gasol
item.description:
Sam Smith:Jimmy Butler on Pau Gasol rumors:

“I love Pau. Pau gives me a lot of easy baskets. A lot now that I think about it. I like playing with Pau.”

Jimmy Butler on Pau Gasol, Feb 12, 2016. Source: Twitter @SamSmithHoops.

item.title: Mitch Kupchak on Pau Gasol
item.description:
The deal was nixed by then-NBA Commissioner David Stern, but the damage was done, and as Lakers general manager Mitch Kupchak told ESPN in December 2014,

“It was really hard on [Gasol] from that one moment when we had a deal that fell through.”

Mitch Kupchak on Pau Gasol, Jan 29, 2016. Source: ESPN.com.

item.title: Kobe Bryant on Pau Gasol, Derek Fisher, Ronny Turiaf
item.description:
“It's very rare for me to open up to somebody like that, but I just had a connection with him. He's one of my favorite teammates. There's Caron, there's Pau [Gasol], there's [Derek Fisher] and Ronnie Turiaf.”

Kobe Bryant on Pau Gasol, Derek Fisher, Ronny Turiaf, Nov 20, 2015. Source: Los Angeles Times.

item.title: Fran Fraschilla on Pau Gasol, Ricky Rubio, Marc Gasol, Serge Ibaka
item.description:
international basketball expert and ESPN analyst Fran Fraschilla told me.

“This team rode the back of a 35-year-old player who in Pau Gasol still has great heart and very good ability. But this is not the same team that challenged the USA for a period of three or four years. I don’t think they will go into 2016 – even though Marc Gasol and Ricky Rubio will be back and potentially Serge Ibaka – as the same threat they were for a period of about four years. But they are the most likely team to knock off the USA in Brazil.”

Fran Fraschilla on Pau Gasol, Ricky Rubio, Marc Gasol, Serge Ibaka, Sep 24, 2015. Source: USA Today Sports.

item.title: Nicolas Batum on Pau Gasol
item.description:
Nicolas Batum:

“I do not like talking about officiating, but Pau Gasol gets protected a bit too much. This is sport, this is how it is. We will never get respect and they will always be the kings of the world.”

Nicolas Batum on Pau Gasol, Sep 18, 2015. Source: BasketSession.com.

item.title: Kobe Bryant on Pau Gasol, Derek Fisher
item.description:
Kobe Bryant:

“There is two. [Shaq?] No it’s not Shaq. But I loved Shaq. Me and Shaq won the thing but I didn’t particularly like playing with him too much. [Laughs] It’s easy. It’s Derek Fisher and Pau Gasol.”

Kobe Bryant on Pau Gasol, Derek Fisher, Jul 13, 2015. Source: The Kobe Team.

item.title: Joakim Noah on Pau Gasol
item.description:
Michael Lee:Noah on Pau Gasol:

“While he’s going to, I think it’s a blizzard in New York, I’m going to the sun, the beach, drink a Red Stripe.”

Joakim Noah on Pau Gasol, Feb 13, 2015. Source: Twitter @MrMichaelLee.

item.title: Taj Gibson on Pau Gasol
item.description:
Sam Smith:Gibson on Gasol at half trailing 63-55:

“Like Pau said at halftime, if we want to do something special we can’t be losing games like this.”

Taj Gibson on Pau Gasol, Jan 13, 2015. Source: Twitter @SamSmithHoops.

item.title: Kobe Bryant on Pau Gasol, Anthony Davis
item.description:
Alex Kennedy:Kobe Bryant on Anthony Davis:

“He's an athletic Pau Gasol... He can be one of the greatest PFs who has ever played.”

Kobe Bryant on Pau Gasol, Anthony Davis, Nov 12, 2014. Source: Twitter @AlexKennedyNBA.

item.title: Steve Nash on Pau Gasol
item.description:
Kevin Ding:Nash on Lakers with @Pau Gasol as interior threat instead of @Dwight Howard:

“It gives us a little more fluidity. The ball can move more.”

Steve Nash on Pau Gasol, Jul 15, 2013. Source: Twitter @KevinDing.

item.title: Dwight Howard on Pau Gasol, Steve Nash
item.description:
“That wasn’t anything that was on my mind. Like I told you guys in the beginning, this is a great time for me to learn from a guy like Kobe, a guy like Steve Nash and Pau Gasol, and that’s what I intended on doing. I’ve learned so much from the beginning of the season until now that it’s going to help me moving forward in my career. So, this has been great. Everything that Kobe is doing, everything that Pau and Steve and those guys are doing will help me in the long run as far as taking a team over the hump.”

Dwight Howard on Pau Gasol, Steve Nash, Mar 18, 2013. Source: ESPN.com.

item.title: Ricky Rubio on Pau Gasol, Mike D'Antoni
item.description:
Ricky Rubio:

“I didn't attack Mike D'Antoni. I said I would be delighted to have Pau Gasol on my team if they didn't want him. I didn't say anything against him, but he took it personal. Besides, Pau is my friend and I think I can talk about my friends.”

Ricky Rubio on Pau Gasol, Mike D'Antoni, Feb 26, 2013. Source: SER.

item.title: Mike D'Antoni on Pau Gasol
item.description:
Ken Berger:D'Antoni on Gasol:

“He will probably do what we ask him to do. I'm not going to Spain to vacation with him this summer, but he's good.”

Mike D'Antoni on Pau Gasol, Feb 5, 2013. Source: Twitter @KBergCBS.

item.title: Bill Laimbeer on Pau Gasol
item.description:
Bill Laimbeer:

“Gasol is still a great player and may be the only player of the team for whom they can get something valuable in return”

Bill Laimbeer on Pau Gasol, Jan 19, 2013. Source: Marca.com.
